sources.entry: Rybbit - Web and products analytics that is easy to setup and more intuitive (alternative to Google Analytics). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker
Rybbit | Privacy-friendly web and product analytics

summary.one_liner: Rybbit is an open source, privacy-friendly web and product analytics tool positioned as an alternative to Google Analytics, available as a hosted service or self-hosted deployment.
summary.what_it_does: Rybbit tracks standard web analytics metrics such as sessions, unique users, pageviews, bounce rate and session duration. It offers session replays, customizable goals, retention, user journey and funnel dashboards, and custom events with JSON properties. Filtering works across 15+ dimensions, and location tracking goes from country to region to city with map visualizations. It also includes a real-time dashboard and supports organizations with an unlimited number of sites. The README's comparison table lists additional features such as error tracking, web vitals, user profiles and public dashboards, though web vitals is marked as paid-tier only. It states it uses no cookies.
use_cases: view session replays of user visits
build conversion funnels and user journeys
how_to_run: Option 1: Use the hosted service (see the project website)
Option 2: Self-host on your own VPS (see the documentation for installation steps)
For local development of client and backend, see the pnpm workspace setup referenced in the README
stack: TypeScript (client and backend, inferred from pnpm workspace setup)
notable: Session replays combined with analytics dashboards
Three-level location tracking with advanced map visualizations
Funnels, retention, and user journey analysis
Error tracking and web vitals listed in comparison table
caveats: Web Vitals is available only on paid tiers or cloud, per the README
Plausible comparison notes its community edition has limited features (not a Rybbit limitation, but context)
Self-hosting requires managing your own VPS; detailed install steps are in external documentation
keywords: see where my visitors come from
